data.gender_notes: Ladeenah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'dana', meaning 'to be gentle, kind, or soft'. This name is often given to girls as a symbol of beauty and grace. It carries the spiritual significance of compassion, kindness, and nurturing in Islam. The name Ladeenah carries the meaning “Gentle, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ladeenah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
